title: Bundle paths pass one_line before joining the worker prompt
action: Review B-P3-3, join site verified at prepare.rs:316-334: the learned-context line is format!("- {path} — {}", one_line(title, 140)) — one_line is applied only to the TITLE; path is raw, and a Linux filename may contain a newline, so a crafted bundle filename forges extra bullet lines inside the worker prompt's Learned context block. Fix: pass the path through the same whitespace-collapsing one_line treatment (length cap generous enough for real paths, e.g. 200) before the format; apply to every sibling join in the same function that interpolates a raw path into a prompt line (check the critical-patterns fallback lines ~391-405 too). TDD red-first: an entry whose path contains a newline renders as ONE line with the newline collapsed; normal paths byte-identical.

truths: a newline-bearing bundle path cannot produce more than one prompt line
normal paths render byte-identical to today

trace.outcome: bundle paths pass one_line (cap 200) before joining the worker prompt; newline-bearing filename renders one collapsed line; normal paths byte-identical
deviations: sweep of the sibling joins at prepare.rs ~391-405 found only static string literals - no raw-path interpolation there, no change needed
